Answer: Dracunculiasis

👀 What you see:
A long white thread coils through the soft tissue of the leg. That thread is a dead worm turned to calcium.

🦴 Why it matters:
The female worm burrows through the tissues for a year before erupting through the skin and once it dies it calcifies and stays visible for life.

💊 Treatment:
The living worm is wound out slowly over days on a stick and the calcified remnant is simply left alone.
